title: Reference Documents
description: Controlled list of the regulatory, industry and internal documents the Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual is governed by.

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

notes: The approved sheet carries NO form number — its only identifiers are ANNEX 1-1 / PGIA 16-14 and the annex letter. None has been invented.
Annex L is a reference list, not an inspection. Every line is pre-printed and is never overlaid, so the portal renders it read-only and offers the approved PDF for viewing.
referenceGroups is a verbatim transcription of the approved sheet — headings, reference codes and wording exactly as printed, including the two identically-named PASER MANUAL rows.

entries.text: Aerodrome Certification, Operation and Surveillance — Belize Civil Aviation Regulations. MANDATORY. Governs aerodrome certification, operational standards, maintenance requirements, and regulatory oversight of PGIA.

Aerodrome Design and Construction — Belize Civil Aviation Regulations. MANDATORY. Establishes design and construction standards for runways, taxiways, aprons, pavements, markings, signs, and lighting at Belizean aerodromes.
Airport Services Manual — Pavement Surface Conditions, 4th Edition, 2002. Guidance on contamination removal, friction measurement, and pavement surface management.
Aerodrome Design Manual — Pavements. Technical guidance on pavement design, construction, and evaluation.
Guidelines and Procedures for Maintenance of Airport Pavements, 2014.
Airport Pavement Management Program, 2015.
Airfield Pavement Surface Evaluation and Rating (PASER) Manual, including Appendix A (Asphalt) and Appendix B (Concrete).
Measurement, Construction, and Maintenance of Skid-Resistant Airport Pavement Surfaces.
Standards for Airport Markings.
Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids.
Airport Design.
Standards for Specifying Construction of Airports.
Operational Safety on Airports During Construction.
Airport Pavement Design and Evaluation.
